profiles.label: Full-service restaurants
profiles.area_defined: All buildings and restaurant areas, including outdoor dining areas where customers dine.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during meal service, preparation, cleaning, and staff operating periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible reduced staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for full-service restaurants, cafes, diners, bistros, family restaurants, and similar food establishments. Good evidence includes customers, patrons, diners, guests, employees, workers, or staff inside, evacuated, rescued, counted during a fire/code/health inspection, or attending a bounded event. Treat restaurant guides, review pages, directory listings, seating capacity, and generic venue pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official health, fire, or code enforcement report
official restaurant statement with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: restaurant directory, review, travel guide, listicle, or map listing
venue marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
social media repost without an original authoritative source

profiles.label: Quick-service restaurants
profiles.area_defined: All buildings and restaurant areas, including customer counters, seating areas, kitchens, and drive-through/customer areas when the count is tied to the facility.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during service, food preparation, and staff operating periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open or closed depending on facility hours, with possible reduced staff.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for fast-food restaurants, quick-service restaurants, takeout shops, food courts, coffee shops, and chain restaurant outlets. Good evidence includes employees, workers, customers, patrons, or staff inside, evacuated, rescued, on duty, or counted during a bounded incident or inspection. Treat restaurant guides, directory listings, seating capacity, and generic venue pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official health, fire, or code enforcement report
official restaurant or franchise statement with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: restaurant directory, review, travel guide, listicle, or map listing
venue marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
social media repost without an original authoritative source

profiles.label: Bars and nightlife
profiles.area_defined: All buildings used for nightlife, music, alcohol service, entertainment, and patron areas.
profiles.day_occurrence: Often closed or lightly staffed during the day.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open during evening and night entertainment periods.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for bars, pubs, breweries, clubs, lounges, nightclubs, and nightlife venues. Good evidence includes patrons, customers, guests, attendees, employees, or staff inside, evacuated, rescued, counted during a police/fire/code operation, or attending a bounded nightlife event. Treat nightlife guides, directory listings, venue capacity, and generic venue pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official fire, police, or code enforcement report
official venue statement with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: bar, nightlife, travel guide, listicle, or map listing
venue marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
social media repost without an original authoritative source
